_comment: Curated Korean duty overlays, applied automatically on every build.
_comment_quota_tariffs: 할당관세 (Customs Act Art. 71) decree annexes made after the KCS rate file we ingest, applied by build_duty_rates.py build_kr. Each entry is one annex: printed 6-digit scopes cover every HSK leaf under them; volume 'all' (수입 전량) or a quantity limit (한계수량). While an annex is in force at the build's snapshot date: an all-volume rate lower than the computed applied rate IS the applied rate served (Customs Act Art. 50: Art. 71 rates take precedence over the basic and provisional rates), dated, with the computed rate scheduled to return the day after; a quantity-limited rate is an informational in-quota row, never auto-selected. KCS quota (P-class) rows for a covered leaf whose window overlaps the annex are superseded and dropped. Annex lines carrying a specification or a national sub-item are listed under not_modelled until mapped.
_coverage: Not an inventory: only the annexes listed here have been read (2026-11-19). 별표 3 (full-year, also amended by 대통령령 제36450호) and the adjustment tariffs (조정관세) are not overlaid; the KCS file's own quota rows stay informational.
